title: Earliest tea as evidence for one branch of the Silk Road across the Tibetan Plateau

passages.quote: Our study reveals that tea was drunk by Han Dynasty emperors as early as 2100 yr BP and had been introduced into the Tibetan Plateau
The first unambiguous textual reference to the consumption of tea as a beverage can be dated to 59 BCE during the Western Han Dynasty

file.method: Passages of about 500 characters either side of each cited quotation, cut from the fetched page text.
